source.title: Fabricating Functionally Graded Materials by Ceramic On-Demand Extrusion with Dynamic Mixing
source.extraction: Manual transcription; Figures 3 and 7 and Table 1 visually checked against PDF
source.reuse_license: No general open-data redistribution license verified; numeric facts attributed; source figures not redistributed

process.reason_for_nulls: Not supplied in the inspected publication; not assumed zero

transition.command: Switch from zirconia to alumina at location 1
transition.measurement_stage: EDS on sintered deposited trace; indirect record of outlet composition
transition.composition_basis: Al atomic counts / (Al + Zr + Y atomic counts); NOT paste or ceramic volume fraction
transition.measurement_sampling: 42 locations, three approximately 120 by 120 micrometre areas at each location
transition.reading_uncertainty_basis: Analyst-assigned visual reading allowance only, not experimental uncertainty or confidence interval
transition.warning: Sample-location spacing is nonuniform; do not assign evenly spaced extrusion volumes. Source completion label does not mean measured 100% Al.

type1_composition.basis: Al atomic percentage as labelled; retain source basis, no conversion to volume fraction
type1_composition.aggregation: Means from two specimens; three sampled regions per layer per specimen; specimen IDs and raw values unavailable
type1_composition.warning: Integer figure labels; rounding is not measurement uncertainty; cannot join these aggregates to specific curling specimens
